name: Ishmerai
title: Benjaminite clan leader
summary: Ishmerai was one of the sons of Elpaal, a descendant of Benjamin. He is mentioned in the genealogical lists in 1 Chronicles as one of the heads of Benjaminite clans living in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jishmerai is listed as one of the sons of Elpaal in the detailed genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Benjamin in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jishmerai belonged to the Benjaminite clans that settled in Jerusalem and served as family heads.

keyEvents.title: Elpaal and His Sons
keyEvents.description: Jishmerai is part of a larger listing of Elpaal's descendants, who played a role in the settlement and organization of the Benjamites.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Benjamin After the Exile
keyEvents.description: The genealogical lists where Jishmerai is mentioned reflect the importance of the Benjamites for the rebuilding and organization of the tribes of Israel, especially in connection with Jerusalem.
